title: Curve
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Curve
learningObjectives: Distinguish the two anchor points a p5.js curve passes through from the two control points that only shape its direction
Predict how dragging a control point changes the curvature and entry tangent of the rendered curve
Explain how curvePoint() evaluates a curve at parameter t between 0 and 1 to return a single x or y coordinate
Trace how a loop over t accumulates curveVertex() calls between beginShape() and endShape() to draw a partial curve
Design a customCurve() function that renders only a given percent of a curve by bounding the t loop
